mapping.gui: roll=a; pitch=e; throttle=t; yaw=r; virtual input bypasses gamepad expo/inversion
mapping.rounding: Python round; clamp signed axes to [-1,1]
mapping.FCU: Plane.manual_override: roll=packet.y; pitch=packet.x with reversed=true; throttle=packet.z; rudder=packet.r
mapping.post_mixer: SERVO1/2 elevon, SERVO3/4 motor; exact FCU functions, trims, min/max and reversal from parameter snapshot
mapping.forbidden_equivalence: pilot != PWM != mechanical angle != spool != RPM; PWM alone proves none of the latter
mapping.mode_discrete: executor dispatches changed mode, then discrete actions, then continuous tick; action receipt is not mode/ARM completion

identity.parameters: complete finite FCU parameter map; digest(parameters) == parameter_snapshot_sha256
identity.comparison: exact hashes rechecked by consumer; structural validation is not provenance verification

state.controller_components: integrators, filters, mode/transition timers and estimator/controller state; name and unit each observed component
state.spool_components: desired/current spool, ramp/timers/arming state; do not infer from disarmed heartbeat or PWM
state.unknown: value=null; source=UNAVAILABLE; explicit unbounded uncertainty and reason; never zero-fill
state.known: observed/estimated value vector with provenance and bounded interval or explicit unbounded uncertainty
state.navigation: MESA/L3 estimate only; FCU/JSBSim truth is evaluation-only and cannot replace navigation

timing.plant_clock: FCU_BOOT seconds; plant_start_bounds_s is an interval, never an invented exact send time
timing.mapping: clock_mapping_sha256 binds explicit native/FCU clock mapping; do not assume JSBSim clock equals FCU_BOOT
timing.grid: N commands; prediction_dt_s each; horizon=N*dt; samples offsets 0,dt,...,N*dt
timing.commit: 0 < close_guard_s < commit_segment_s <= prediction_dt_s; commit is only first move
timing.deadline: UNIX_WALL admission deadline distinct from FCU_BOOT exposure and HOST_MONOTONIC TTL
timing.cadence: execution_rate_hz and gui_rate_hz explicit; gui_ttl_s=max(.15,3/execution_rate_hz); 30Hz is not 10Hz control
timing.post_commit: latch stop/cancel prevents replay; FCU override timeout, failsafe and mode still govern plant; no physical HOLD implied

isolation: ISOLATED_REPLAY_ONLY; branch differs from mission session; restore/reference hash required; active mission never advanced

response.binding: request_sha256 covers complete immutable request; plan/state/parameters/env cannot be substituted
response.evidence: trace SHA256 + isolated branch session + initial reference hash; no ACK-as-prediction
response.uncertainty: any unbounded initial state requires unbounded output uncertainty; bounded forecasts require independent R7.04/05 qualification
response.comparability: same offsets, mode, units, frames and post-mixer channels; motor speed unavailable unless native/measured source exists
response.unavailable: reason required; samples=[]; no synthetic nominal response

acceptance_boundary: R7.01 validates structure only; replay R7.02; prediction R7.03; tolerance/validation R7.04; certificate R7.05; L4 integration R7.06; FINAL R7.07
